propositions: A plan edited mid-review currently runs all remaining LLM passes and fails only at sign time when generation.sign_manifest detects own_material mismatch, wasting all post-edit billing and checkpoint I/O
The cancel predicate must scope to own material only (not relation snapshot or store-wide state) to avoid false cancels on unrelated ticket writes (d70a regression)
The cancel signal must be checked by produce_plan_review_verdict before recovery paths that would flow to sidecar.emit and advance store revision

Probe placement at the two between-pass seams (after finders before verify, after decide before coach) detects own-material drift via attest.current_material_fingerprint under local_read_context without fetch/reconverge or sync-lock
A cancelled run returns an unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict with plan-review-cancelled-stale finding and skips floors, signing, and sidecar emission
In-flight pool workers check review_cancelled() via ContextVar to short-circuit chunk processing without checkpoint I/O
